response.original_title: Can I add a passenger to my P&O Cruises?
response.overview: Yes, you can add a passenger to an existing P&O Cruises booking by calling their Customer Contact Centre or your travel agent, as additions cannot be processed online.  Important Details for Adding a Guest  Cabin & Ship Capacity: Adding a passenger depends on your stateroom's maximum occupancy (such as third/fourth upper berths or sofa beds) and the overall lifeboat and ship safety capacity.  Booking Source: If you booked directly, call P&O Cruises (UK customers can call 1-855-732-4023 (US/Canada) +44-289-708-0062 (UK)). If you booked through a travel advisor or agent, they must handle the modification for you.  Pricing & Fees: Your booking may be re-priced at current active fare rates, and additional charges or fares for the new guest will apply.  Timing: It is best to request additions as early as possible before final manifests are submitted or final payments are due.
